findings.fact: Accepts exactly float64 THWC arrays d_a,d_b,v_a,v_b, T 1..2, H/W 3..5, C=3; returns q4_direct plus compact/z diagnostics and no classifier.
Real wrapper is pending and input contract is tiny synthetic THWC; no BCTHW or 17-frame media/probe interface is bound.
Stable r_K path reuses archived q and stable four_term_score; fixed_objective is a 12-dimensional abstract arithmetic function. AL32 explicitly did not call AE, probe, optimizer or real classifier.
Intended real OR1 requires fixed public reconstructors R_a/R_b, h=1/8 and four complete AE calls per sample before q; identities/weights/wrapper and output projection to C=3 are not frozen.

q is contained in the same-call stable r descriptor; a fair comparison must fit q-only and r/full heads on the same probe outputs, same pairing/selection/calibration and same regularization budget. The current artifacts do not implement this evaluator.
AL67/AL69-AL73 evidence leaves native time, ancestry, labels, licensing and split/source risks open; no real sample can be released by this review.

minimum_bridge_task.title: Freeze one ProbeBatch adapter and paired q-vs-r evaluator after AL36/data gates
inputs: one authorized sample manifest with roles/splits
outputs: q-only and r/full heads with identical fit budget
minimum_bridge_task.resource_not_authorized_here: Any model/media/server/GPU run remains a separate gate.

decision: Current artifacts support software arithmetic only; no fair real-data paired baseline is executable yet, and OR1 remains not admitted.
